description:
Assign a tag to a graph artifact, the same write that `rover graph-artifact tag` performs.
If the tag does not exist, it is created.
If it exists, it moves to this artifact, and any router that fetches by that tag receives the new artifact.
Returns the artifact's ID and digest, or an error with a message.
Provide the graph ID, the tag name, and the artifact digest.
name: TagGraphArtifact
